description: V0.12.2 curated naming batch 3 (32 new entries on top of V0.12.1's 28). Manual disasm reading of top caller-count functions not yet named.

names.name: state_set_gated_on_global_910
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #0x14]; ldr r1, [r1]; sub r1, r1, #9; cmp r1, #1; ldrhi r1, [pc, #8]; strhi r0, [r1]
names.note: Gated write: only writes r0 to second global IF first global in [9, 10]. 49 callers - most-called remaining sub.

names.name: dcache_clean_range
names.disasm: add r1, r1, r0; bic r0, r0, #0x1f; mcr p15, #0, r0, c7, c10, #1; add r0, r0, #0x20; cmp r0, r1; blt ...
names.note: ARM mode D-cache clean range loop (mcr c7,c10,#1 = clean D-cache MVA). 24 callers.

names.name: dcache_clean_invalidate_range
names.note: D-cache clean+invalidate range (mcr c7,c10,#4 = clean by Set/Way, then c7,c14,#1 = clean+inv MVA). 24 callers.

names.name: float32_unpack_bits
names.disasm: and r2, r0, #0x80000000; lsr ip, r0, #0x17; lsl r3, r0, #9; ands ip, ip, #0xff; beq ...
names.note: Float32 bit-unpack: sign bit, exponent (bits 23-30), mantissa (bits 0-22). 23 callers - likely __aeabi_* helper.

names.name: arm7_ipc_fifo_send_low
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; ldr r2, [pc, #0x28]; strh r1, [r2]; orr r1, r0, #0x5000; ldr r0, [pc, #0x20]; ...
names.note: ARM7 IPC FIFO write (ORR #0x5000 = IPCFIFOSEND signature, strh writes low halfword). 22 callers.

names.name: arm7_audio_init_chain
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; bl #0x2399520; mov r0, #1; bl #0x239a574; add sp, sp, #4; ...
names.note: ARM7 audio init trampoline (calls init helper + sets r0=1 then dispatches). 21 callers - audio subsystem startup.

names.name: frame_setup_with_cache_check
names.disasm: push {r0, r1, r2, r3}; stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; bl #0x2043aa0; cmp r0, #0; addne sp, sp, #4; ...
names.note: Saves 4 args + lr then calls cache check helper. 20 callers - frame setup with side-effect validation.

names.name: memcpy_4byte_chunks
names.disasm: add ip, r1, r2; cmp r1, ip; ldmlt r0!, {r2}; stmlt r1!, {r2}; blt ...
names.note: ARM-mode memcpy using 4-byte (1-word) chunks via ldmia/stmia. 19 callers.

names.name: float32_compare_abs
names.disasm: bic r3, r1, #0x80000000; ldr r2, [pc, #0x3c]; subs r2, r2, r3, lsr #20; ble ...
names.note: Float32 absolute-value comparison (clear sign bit, compare exponent). 19 callers - likely __aeabi_fcmp helper.

names.name: memset_4byte_chunks
names.disasm: add ip, r1, r2; cmp r1, ip; stmlt r1!, {r0}; blt ...
names.note: ARM-mode memset (4-byte chunks). 18 callers - paired with memcpy_4byte_chunks.

names.name: global_array_set_field_0x18
names.disasm: ldr r2, [pc, #0xc]; ldr r2, [r2]; add r0, r2, r0, lsl #2; str r1, [r0, #0x18]; bx lr
names.note: Writes r1 to global_array[r0].field_0x18 (4-byte stride). 18 callers.

names.name: arm7_ipc_fifo_send_high
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; orr r1, r0, #0x6000; ldr r0, [pc, #0x18]; strh r1, [r0]; bl ...
names.note: ARM7 IPC FIFO write (ORR #0x6000). 17 callers - high-halfword IPCFIFOSEND variant.

names.name: arm7_table_0x31c_get_ptr
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #0x10]; ldr r1, [r1]; ldr r2, [r1, #0x31c]; mov r1, #0x1c; mla r0, r1, r0, r2; bx lr
names.note: Returns ptr to global_table.field_0x31c[idx] with 28-byte (0x1c) stride. 17 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_c
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (third variant). 16 callers.

names.name: early_return_if_arg1_eq_2
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; cmp r1, #2; addeq sp, sp, #4; ldmeq sp!, {lr}; bxeq lr; ...
names.note: Bail out if arg1 == 2 (manual stack unwind before return). 16 callers - common guard pattern.

names.name: state_field_get_branch_on_arg1
names.disasm: cmp r1, #0; ldreq r0, [r0]; ldrhne r0, [r0, #0xa]; addne r0, r1, r0; ldrne r0, [r0, #4]; bx lr
names.note: Conditional: if r1==0 deref word, else do offset+word load (16-bit offset + 32-bit fetch). 15 callers.

names.name: dcache_build_mva_register
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; ldr r3, [sp]; and r0, r0, #0x1f; bic r3, r3, #0x1f; orr ip, r3, r0; ...
names.note: Builds p15 c7 MVA register value (align to 32 + combine with index bits). 15 callers - cache control helper.

names.name: alloc_or_init_with_4args
names.disasm: push {r0, r1, r2, r3}; push {r4, r5, lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; mov r4, r0; bl #0x2043bfc; movs r5, r0; ...
names.note: Saves 4 args + calls alloc helper. 15 callers - likely pool alloc with init args preserved.

names.name: tail_call_to_global_arg2_zero
names.disasm: ldr ip, [pc, #4]; mov r3, #0; bx ip
names.note: Tail-calls global fn with r3=0. 14 callers - inline helper forwarding.

names.name: clamp_idx_to_global_count
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #0x1c]; ldr r1, [r1]; ldr r2, [r1, #0x84]; ldr r1, [r2, #8]; cmp r0, r1; movhs r0, #0; ...
names.note: If r0 >= global.field_0x84.field_0x8 (count), r0 = 0. 13 callers - array index clamp.

names.name: dual_state_setter
names.disasm: ldr r2, [pc, #0xc]; ldr r1, [pc, #0xc]; str r0, [r2]; str r0, [r1, #4]; bx lr
names.note: Writes r0 to two globals (one direct, one at offset +4). 12 callers - paired state setter.

names.name: array_lookup_by_field_0xa_offset
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; ldrh ip, [r0, #0xa]; ldr r3, [r1, ip]; add lr, r1, ip; cmp r3, #0; ...
names.note: Loads 16-bit offset from obj.field_0xa, indexes arr[offset]. 12 callers.

names.name: vec2_compare_2x4byte
names.disasm: ldr r3, [r1]; ldr r2, [r0]; cmp r2, r3; bge ...
names.note: Compares two 2-component (4-byte each) vectors - vec2.less_than? 11 callers.

names.name: global_halfword_set
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; strh r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Writes uint16 r0 to global ptr. 11 callers - halfword setter.

names.name: dcache_invalidate_all
names.note: Invalidate entire D-cache (mcr c7,c10,#4 then c7,c14,#2). 11 callers - full cache flush.

names.name: bitfield_test_in_global_group
names.disasm: ldr r2, [pc, #0x1c]; mov r3, #1; add r1, r2, r1, lsl #2; lsl r2, r3, r0; ldr r0, [r1, #0x388]; ands r0, r2, r0; ...
names.note: Tests bit r0 in global_array[r1][0x388] bitfield. 11 callers - flag/permission check.

names.name: arm7_struct_init_3field
names.disasm: mvn r2, #0; str r2, [r0]; str r2, [r0, #4]; mov r2, #0; strh r2, [r0, #8]; strh r1, [r0, #0xa]; ...
names.note: ARM7 struct init: word+0+word+4 = -1, half+8 = 0, half+0xa = r1. 11 callers.

names.name: early_return_if_global_eq_arg0
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; ldr r1, [pc, #0x34]; ldr r2, [r1]; cmp r2, r0; addeq sp, sp, #4; ...
names.note: Bail out if global value == arg0. 10 callers - state-change guard.

names.name: null_check_deref_dispatch
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; ldr r2, [r0]; cmp r2, #0; bne ...
names.note: If *r0 != 0 jumps to one branch, else calls helper. 10 callers - pointer dispatch.

names.name: struct_init_3field_with_arg1
names.disasm: mov r2, #0; str r2, [r0]; str r2, [r0, #4]; strh r2, [r0, #8]; strh r1, [r0, #0xa]; bx lr
names.note: Zeroes word+0, word+4, half+8 then writes r1 to half+0xa. 10 callers - struct reset pattern.

names.name: memset_halfword_chunks
names.disasm: mov r3, #0; cmp r3, r2; strhlt r0, [r1, r3]; addlt r3, r3, #2; blt ...
names.note: 16-bit memset loop. 10 callers - halfword fill.

names.name: arm7_clamped_lookup_field_8
names.disasm: cmp r1, #0xf; movgt r0, #0; bxgt lr; add r0, r0, r1; ldrb r1, [r0, #8]; cmp r1, #0xff; ...
names.note: Clamps r1 to [0, 15] then loads byte at offset 8. 10 callers - ARM7 indexed lookup.
